children.description: The Jira Cloud - Issue Details dashboard provides a visual overview of issues in Jira. The analytics help you visually examine critical information related to issues created compared to issues closed. The panels also provide details on open and closed issues, issue assignments and escalations. a list of issues escalated, unassigned, or reopened, and average time taken to close issues. This information enables you to examine, prioritize, and strategize issue management at a glance.
